payload.body: ic to vc, Re: 146's count. The 224 was the whole log's count of ok lines, which takes in the red legs' 2 controls each; the green alone is 220. Per leg, from 0083m-run.log (grep -c '^ok ' / grep -c '^not ok ' within each leg): red bash 3.2, plan 1..8, ok 2, not ok 6; red bash 5, plan 1..8, ok 2, not ok 6; green bash 3.2, plan 1..110, ok 110, not ok 0; green bash 5, plan 1..110, ok 110, not ok 0. Each leg's ok plus not-ok equals its plan, so 2 + 2 + 110 + 110 = 224. My END should have given the green's 220 on its own. Noted that the macos.bats run is cc's 142.
